misconceptions.wrong_concept: Object Oriented programming is a method of implementation in which programs are organized as a simple collection of objects
misconceptions.correct_concept: Object Oriented programming is a method of implementation in which programs are organized as cooperative collections of objects, each of which represents an instance of some class, and whose classes are all members of a hierarchy of classes united via inheritance relationships.
misconceptions.reason: Students may think that OOP is just a simple way to organize objects, but it's actually a complex method that involves cooperation and hierarchy.
misconceptions.user_explanation: Marked as verified and correct by teacher.

questions.question: What would happen if a new class, 'Vehicle', was added to a program that already had classes 'Car' and 'Motorcycle'?
questions.expected_answer: The Vehicle class would be a member of a hierarchy of classes united via inheritance relationships.

questions.question: What would happen if a new object, 'ElectricCar', was created in a program that already had objects 'Car' and 'Motorcycle'?
questions.expected_answer: The ElectricCar object would be an instance of some class, and whose class would be a member of a hierarchy of classes united via inheritance relationships.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about Object Oriented Programming?
questions.expected_answer: Object Oriented programming is a method of implementation in which programs are organized as cooperative collections of objects, each of which represents an instance of some class, and whose classes are all members of a hierarchy of classes united via inheritance relationships.

misconceptions.wrong_concept: Object Oriented Programming is only used in Java
misconceptions.correct_concept: Object Oriented Programming is a programming paradigm that can be used in various programming languages, including C++ and Java.
misconceptions.reason: Students may think that OOP is specific to Java, but it's actually a programming paradigm that can be applied to any language that supports OOP.
misconceptions.user_explanation: Marked as verified and correct by teacher.

questions.question: What would happen if you were building a game in C++ and wanted to use the concept of inheritance to create a hierarchy of characters? Would the game still be playable?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, the game would still be playable.

questions.question: What would happen if you were building a mobile app in Python and wanted to use encapsulation to hide the implementation details of a class? Would the app still function correctly?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, the app would still function correctly.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true? Object-Oriented Programming is only used in Java, or Object-Oriented Programming is a programming paradigm supported by many programming languages?
questions.expected_answer: Object-Oriented Programming is a programming paradigm supported by many programming languages.

misconceptions.wrong_concept: A class is just a collection of data
misconceptions.correct_concept: A class is the abstract definition of the data type, including the data elements that are part of the data type, and the operations which are defined on the data type.
misconceptions.reason: Students may think that a class is just a collection of data, but it's actually a blueprint for creating objects that have both data and behavior.
misconceptions.user_explanation: Marked as verified and correct by teacher.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Object Oriented Programming?
options: To organize code into simple collections of objects
To implement a method of implementation in which programs are organized as a simple collection of objects
To define a programming paradigm that can be used in various languages
To create a hierarchy of classes united via inheritance relationships
